name: JW Marriott Hotel Tokyo
positioning: Zen-inspired high-rise hotel in Takanawa Gateway City, Tokyo, a one-minute walk from Takanawa Gateway Station, with a 28th-floor spa and Mindful Rooms
best_for: Travelers who want quick rail access from Takanawa Gateway Station
Wellness-minded guests who want Mindful Rooms, Spa by JW and a quiet meditation space
Travelers who want views of Tokyo Bay and the city skyline

facts.text: The hotel is in Takanawa, a one-minute walk from Takanawa Gateway Station.
The hotel occupies a number of floors in a high-rise building called The Link.
The hotel is inspired by Zen philosophy and the natural beauty of Goten-yama.
Rooms and suites have floor-to-ceiling windows with views of Tokyo Bay and the city skyline.
Mindful Rooms are on the hotel's dedicated Mindful Floor.
Mindful Rooms include yoga mats, meditation tools and organic herbal teas.
The Presidential Suite has generous living and dining areas.
Spa by JW is on the 28th floor.
The hotel has a 24-hour fitness center and an indoor pool.
Serene Space is a quiet space for meditation and reflection on the lobby level, open to all guests.
Kako serves sashimi, Wagyu and tempura, paired with sake from 47 prefectures.
4-0-3 is a hidden bar behind JW Bar.

highlights.text: The Private Night Pool is surrounded by the Tokyo skyline, including views of Tokyo Tower.
Mindful Rooms come with yoga mats, meditation tools and organic herbal teas.
Floor-to-ceiling windows frame views of Tokyo Bay and the city skyline.
The hotel's design is inspired by Zen philosophy and the natural beauty of Goten-yama.

considerations.text: There is a lot of construction outside, as the area is still developing.
Rooms have limited space for luggage.
